title: 第48章 火鸦崖城第47章 毒袭圣灵
lines: 神魂深处焚魂剧痛翻涌不休，火山浑身僵直，猩红竖瞳死死盯着下方的白枫，眼底写满极致的错愕与不敢置信，声音都因神魂刺痛而微微发颤：
“你……你怎么会掌控雾渊泽独有的神魂毒？你明明踏入泽中不过短短一月有余，怎么可能参悟此地本源毒道？这到底是怎么回事！”
雾渊神魂毒乃是天地自生的禁地本源规则，即便是他踏入沼泽边缘，都不敢沾染分毫，一个神游境修士，非但没有被毒素吞噬，反倒反过来掌控了这无解剧毒，完全颠覆了他的认知。
白枫神色漠然，懒得回应他的诘问，趁着火山神魂剧痛、战力短暂断层的空隙，立刻闭目全力催动闵天幡内的功德金光，温润纯净的功德之力席卷全身，飞速修复方才硬接圣灵一掌留下的重创经脉与肉身伤口。
看着白枫安然调息、借机疗伤的模样，再感受着识海之中不断肆虐啃噬神魂的剧毒，火山心底最后一丝从容彻底崩塌，滔天怒意彻底吞噬理智。
丧子之恨、被小辈偷袭羞辱之恨、神魂被毒折磨之痛，尽数叠加在一起。
他不再保留任何力量，也顾不得神魂毒素蔓延，仰天发出一声暴怒鸦鸣，周身万丈血色鸦火冲天而起，漫天锋利如火的赤红火羽铺满整片天穹，遮天蔽日。
“不知天高地厚的人族蝼蚁，既然你执意找死，那我便倾尽圣灵全力，将你挫骨扬灰！”
这是火山毫无保留的圣灵绝杀一击，整片空域都被鸦火焚烧得扭曲塌陷，空间裂纹纵横交错，毁灭气息压得大地不断崩裂下沉。
白枫心头一凛，神色彻底凝重。
此刻整片空间依旧被火山提前禁锢，他根本无法瞬移逃离，直面圣灵毫无保留的大招，一味防守只会被活活耗死。
守不如攻，唯有主动破局才有一线生机！
白枫牙关一咬，不顾肉身尚未痊愈的伤势，将闵天幡功德防御催动至极限，同时反手拔出腰间碧玉长剑。
下一刻，他主动将体内凝练圆满的神魂毒尽数灌注剑身，澄澈的碧玉长剑瞬间覆上一层幽深诡秘的幽绿毒芒，剑气之内藏蚀魂剧毒，无声无息，杀人无形。
没有花哨招式，白枫手持毒剑，孤身迎着漫天焚天火羽，径直逆行而上！
极致刺眼的火光与幽绿毒光轰然碰撞，光芒席卷千里，灼目强光笼罩四方，轰鸣巨响震彻整片荒野。
片刻后，强光散尽，天地重归平静。
火山凌空立于半空，粗重喘着粗气，胸口一道深可见骨的狭长剑痕撕裂战甲，皮肉外翻，剑气残留的神魂毒还在不断侵蚀他的伤口，让他伤势迟迟无法愈合。
他低头看着下方空荡荡的地面，再也感知不到白枫丝毫气息，紧绷的身躯微微放松，眼底杀意稍缓，冷笑着自语：
“终究是神游境蝼蚁，接不下我圣灵全力一击，终究还是化作飞灰消散了。
总算除掉这个心腹大患，也能告慰我儿在天之灵。”
可他话音刚落，地面一堆焦黑灰烬忽然轻轻一动。
紧接着，一道狼狈不堪的身影缓缓从灰烬之中爬出。
白枫浑身黑袍彻底碎裂，原本坚韧无比、由天南圣人皮囊炼制而成的护身黑袍，此刻破烂不堪，布满烧灼裂痕，彻底失去了所有防护作用，再也无法修补复用。
白枫低头看着手中残破的黑袍碎片，眸底掠过一丝真切的心疼。
这件黑袍一路伴他走过无数险境，替他抵挡过无数致命伤害，帮他死里逃生无数次，如今彻底损毁，再无复原可能。
他沉默片刻，小心翼翼将所有黑袍碎片收起，妥善收入储物戒之中，留作念想。
做完这一切，白枫周身只剩一条单薄裤衩，孤身立于满目疮痍的荒野之上，抬头望向高空一脸错愕的火山，眉眼依旧冷淡，高声开口挑衅：
“火山，别急着庆幸，我还没死，再来一战。”
高空之上，火山彻底呆滞，瞪大双眼看着下方只穿一条裤衩、浑身狼狈却依旧战意不减的白枫，大脑一片空白。
content_en:
The soul-burning pain surged endlessly in the depths of his soul. Huo Huan's whole body stiffened, and his scarlet vertical pupils stared at Bai Feng below. His eyes were filled with extreme astonishment and disbelief, and his voice trembled slightly due to the pain of his soul:
"You...how do you control the unique soul poison of Wuyuanze? You have only been in the swamp for just over a month, how can you understand the original poisonous path here? What is going on!"
Wuyuan Divine Soul Poison is the original rule of the forbidden land created by heaven and earth. Even if he stepped into the edge of the swamp, he would not dare to be contaminated at all. Instead of being swallowed by the poison, a monk in the Ascension Realm could control this poison without any cure, completely subverting his cognition.
Bai Feng looked indifferent and was too lazy to respond to his questioning. Taking advantage of the sharp pain of the volcano soul and the brief interruption in combat power, he immediately closed his eyes and used all his strength to activate the golden light of merit in Min Tianban. The warm and pure power of merit swept through his body, quickly repairing the severely damaged meridians and physical wounds left by the Holy Spirit's palm just now.
Seeing Bai Feng calmly adjusting his breath and taking the opportunity to heal his wounds, and then feeling the poison that was constantly gnawing at the soul in the sea of ​​consciousness, the last trace of calmness in Huo Huo's heart completely collapsed, and the overwhelming anger completely swallowed up his reason.
The hatred of losing his son, the hatred of being sneak-attacked and humiliated by his juniors, and the pain of his soul being tortured by poison, all were added together.
He no longer retained any strength, nor did he care about the spread of poison in his soul. He raised his head to the sky and let out a furious crow. Tens of thousands of bloody crow fires shot up into the sky, and the sky was filled with sharp red fire feathers that covered the entire sky, covering the sky and blocking out the sun.
"You ant of the human race who doesn't know the heights of the world, since you insist on seeking death, then I will use all the strength of my Holy Spirit to crush you to ashes!"
This was the ultimate blow of the Holy Spirit without any reservation from the volcano. The entire airspace was twisted and collapsed by the crow fire. The cracks in the space were crisscrossed, and the earth was constantly cracking and sinking under the pressure of the aura of destruction.
Bai Feng's heart trembled, and his expression became completely solemn.
At this moment, the entire space was still imprisoned by the volcano in advance. He could not teleport away at all. Faced with the Holy Spirit's unreserved ultimate move, blindly defending would only lead to him being consumed alive.
It is better to defend than to attack. Only by taking the initiative to break the situation can you have a chance of survival!
Bai Feng gritted his teeth, and regardless of the physical injuries that had not yet healed, he pushed Min Tianban's meritorious defense to the limit, and at the same time pulled out the jade sword from his waist with his backhand.
The next moment, he took the initiative to pour all the condensed and perfect soul poison in his body into the sword body. The clear jasper sword was instantly covered with a layer of deep and mysterious green poisonous light. The sword energy contained the soul-corrupting poison, which was silent and invisible.
There are no fancy moves, Bai Feng holds a poisonous sword, facing the sky-burning fire feathers all by himself, and goes straight up in the opposite direction!
boom--!
The extremely dazzling firelight collided with the green poisonous light. The light swept thousands of miles, the scorching light enveloped all directions, and the roaring sound shook the entire wilderness.
After a while, the strong light dissipated, and the world returned to calm.
Huoshan stood in mid-air, breathing heavily. A long and narrow sword mark on his chest tore through his armor, causing his skin and flesh to turn outwards. The remaining soul poison from the sword energy was still eroding his wound, making it impossible for him to heal.
He looked down at the empty ground below, and could no longer feel the slightest breath of Bai Feng. His tense body relaxed slightly, the murderous intent in his eyes softened slightly, and he sneered to himself:
"After all, it was an ant in the Divine Ascension Realm. It couldn't withstand the full blow of my Holy Spirit, so it turned into ashes and dissipated.
Finally getting rid of this serious problem can also comfort my son's spirit in heaven. "
But as soon as he finished speaking, a pile of blackened ashes on the ground suddenly moved slightly.
Immediately afterwards, a wretched figure slowly climbed out of the ashes.
Bai Feng's black robe was completely shattered. The originally tough protective black robe made from the skin of the Tiannan Saint was now in tatters and covered with burn cracks. It had completely lost all protective effects and could no longer be repaired and reused.
Bai Feng looked down at the broken black robe fragments in his hands, and a trace of real distress flashed across his eyes.
This black robe has accompanied him through countless dangerous situations, resisted countless fatal injuries for him, and helped him escape from death countless times. Now it is completely destroyed and there is no possibility of recovery.
He was silent for a moment, carefully put away all the fragments of the black robe, put them properly into the storage ring, and kept them for thoughts.
After doing all this, Bai Feng was left with only a pair of thin pants, standing alone in the devastated wilderness, looking up at the astonished volcano in the sky, his eyebrows were still cold, and he spoke provocatively:
"Huo Huo, don't rush to rejoice. I'm not dead yet. Let's fight again."
High in the sky, Huoshan was completely sluggish. His eyes widened as he stared at Bai Feng, who was wearing only a pair of underpants and looking miserable but still fighting spirit. His mind went blank.
